build_appconfig_from_env: build an AppConfig instance by loading all sub-configs from environment variables
create_appconfig_with_defaults: create an AppConfig with all sub-configs using their default factory values
review_appconfig_structure: review the AppConfig dataclass fields and their default factory initializers
summarize_appconfig_from_env: summarize how AppConfig.from_env aggregates CommonConfig, ApiConfig, and other sub-configs
test_appconfig_from_env: test that AppConfig.from_env correctly loads all sub-configs from environment variables
